[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Logging, Monitoring, and Error Tracking in Flask"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Building a robust Flask application requires more than just writing features. You need deep visibility into how your application performs in production. This tutorial covers setting up structured logging, performance monitoring, and real-time error tracking."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Advanced Application Logging"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Flask relies on Python's built-in logging module. By default, it outputs to standard error. For production systems, you should configure a proper logging format that includes timestamps, log levels, and module names."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"import logging
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
import os

def configure_logging(app):
    if not os.path.exists('logs'):
        os.mkdir('logs')
    
    file_handler = RotatingFileHandler('logs/flask_app.log', maxBytes=10240000, backupCount=10)
    file_handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter(
        '%(asctime)s %(levelname)s: %(message)s [in %(pathname)s:%(lineno)d]'
    ))
    file_handler.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    
    app.logger.addHandler(file_handler)
    app.logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    app.logger.info('Flask application startup')"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Integrating Error Tracking with Sentry"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"While logs capture events, error tracking tools like Sentry automatically capture unhandled exceptions, stack traces, and request contexts. from sentry_sdk.integrations.flask import FlaskIntegration

sentry_sdk.init(
    dsn="YOUR_SENTRY_DSN_HERE",
    integrations=[FlaskIntegration()],
    traces_sample_rate=1.0,
    send_default_pii=True
)"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"3. You can integrate Prometheus into Flask using the prometheus-flask-exporter package."},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"from flask import Flask
from prometheus_flask_exporter import PrometheusMetrics

app = Flask(__name__)
metrics = PrometheusMetrics(app)

# Static information as a metric
metrics.info('app_info', 'Application info', version='1.0.3')

@app.route('/')
def index():
    return "Hello, Monitoring!""},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices Summary"},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Always log exceptions with full tracebacks using app.logger.exception."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Do not log sensitive data such as passwords, session tokens, or PII (Personally Identifiable Information)."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use environment variables to configure logging levels and DSNs dynamically."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Set up alert rules in your monitoring platform for high HTTP 5xx error rates."}]
